stem: The weekly profit, in dollars, made by a certain firm has a normal distribution. In the past, the weekly profit had the distribution $\text{N}(736, 26^2)$. Following a change in management, the mean weekly profit for 35 randomly chosen weeks is \$725.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: Stating a necessary assumption, test at the 2% significance level whether the mean weekly profit has decreased.

parts.label: (b)
parts.stem: The mean weekly profit for another random sample of 35 weeks is found and a similar test is carried out at the 2% significance level.
parts.text: State the probability of a Type I error.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Given that the mean weekly profit is now in fact \$718, find the probability of a Type II error.
